prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **World Martial Arts Academy**. It offers children’s classes from about age 4, including a program for ages 6–10, and is at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd**. The school lists a free introductory class; call **(636) 928-0001** to confirm current class times and availability. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

A couple of other options, depending on what your child wants:

- **All Star Karate** — karate for young children through teens; **235 Jungermann Road, Suite 101**; **(636) 279-3730**. It advertises a trial for new students. [Website](https://allstarkarate.com/)
- **Onyx Grappling** — children’s Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes; **953 Jungermann Road**; **(636) 339-4277**. [Website](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

I’d visit or try a class before enrolling. Watch how instructors handle beginners, whether kids are grouped by age and experience, and whether the school explains its fees and contract terms clearly.
